arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 120 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, random, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import ref, gen
src = open('/tmp/gen3.py').read().replace("main()\n","")
g3 = type(sys)('g3'); exec(compile(src,'g3','exec'), g3.__dict__)
rng = random.Random(21)
for i in range(8):
    doc = g3.gen3(rng, 9)
    if doc is None:
        print(i, 'None'); continue
    _l,_r,final=ref.peel_naive(ref.aggregate([(tuple(r['path']),r['count']) for r in doc['rib']], set(doc['ixps'])))
    cl=sorted({ref.canon(p[j],p[j+1]) for p in final for j in range(len(p)-1)})
    sc = gen.scopes_of(cl, final)
    adj=[set() for _ in cl]
    for s in sc:
        for x in range(len(s)):
            for y in range(x+1,len(s)):
                adj[s[x]].add(s[y]); adj[s[y]].add(s[x])
    print(i,'rib',len(doc['rib']),'corelinks',len(cl),'degrees',sorted(len(a) for a in adj))
EOF
